d: Nine days after a crushing Republican midterm defeat, Donald Trump appears to be turning his frustration inwards, with Vice-President JD Vance emerging as his latest target. Trump has stripped Vance of his role in Iran peace negotiations, exposing growing tensions over a war that Vance has openly blamed for the party’s electoral losses. As Trump struggles to navigate a conflict threatening his presidency, the White House is witnessing an increasingly public power struggle.
